entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return.
Okay, I can help with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order is 772-V-901. It's for the VeloBand.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 2nd. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. It's hard to use, and frankly, the whole interface is confusing. Just give me a yes or no, can I return it?

I understand your frustration, and I want to make sure we explore all the options. Can you tell me what part of the interface you're finding confusing? Sometimes a quick tip can make all the difference.
Look, I expected more. I'm trying to see my live stats when I'm running, and it just shows a clock. The user manual is useless. I just want my money back.

Ah, I think I know exactly what's happening, and it's a very easy fix. That's a power-saving feature. When you have a workout started, you just need to double-tap the screen to cycle through your live data displays. Have you tried that?
Double-tap? The manual didn't say that. Hold on...
Take your time. Just start an activity, and then give the screen a quick, firm double-tap.
...Okay, I'm doing it. Well, what do you know. There's the heart rate. And cadence. Why isn't that the default view?
It defaults to the clock face to maximize battery life, but once you know the double-tap, you have instant access to everything. Does knowing how to access those live stats resolve the issue for you?
Yeah, actually. That was my main problem with it. Fine. I'll keep it. This works.
I'm so glad we could get that sorted out for you, Mark. I'll also pass your feedback about the user manual on to our team. Is there anything else I can help with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
